verdict.rationale: Seeing whether and when recipients opened an email is a fair question for an email client like Outlook, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents read receipts or open tracking. Message trace (outlook-docs-15) tracks messages through the Exchange organization, and change notifications cover the user's own resources; both are adjacent features, not recipient-open tracking.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can see whether and when recipients opened my email
